column1: This subdivision is in an agricultural area and each lot owner, its successors or assigns shall have no basis for recourse against the effects of any normal farming operations conducted in accordance with good husbandry practices which may cause some interference with the use and enjoyment of the property. These effects include but are not limited to noise, odor, vibration, fumes, dust or glare. The lot owner shall accept the limitations on use and enjoyment affecting the property.
